CustomField.description: The date the point BECAME public. LSV § 4 Abs. 3: the notification duties apply afresh when an existing charge point newly becomes publicly accessible - so this is a transition, not an attribute, and the date is what the two-week clock runs from. A point that was public from the start carries the Inbetriebnahme date here.
CustomField.label: Öffentlich zugänglich seit
